Question: Show the latest sensor reading recorded for asset CAP-001.

rank_trace.sql:
SELECT sr.reading_time, sr.sensor_type, sr.reading_value, sr.unit  
   FROM sensor_readings sr  
   JOIN assets a ON sr.asset_id = a.asset_id  
   WHERE a.asset_name = 'CAP-001'  
   ORDER BY sr.reading_time DESC  
   LIMIT 1;

SELECT sr.reading_time, sr.sensor_type, sr.reading_value, sr.unit  
   FROM sensor_readings sr  
   JOIN assets a ON sr.asset_id = a.asset_id  
   JOIN work_orders wo ON a.asset_id = wo.asset_id  
   WHERE a.asset_name = 'CAP-001' AND wo.fault_code = 'CAP'  
   ORDER BY sr.reading_time DESC  
   LIMIT 1;

SELECT sr.reading_time, sr.sensor_type, sr.reading_value, sr.unit

   JOIN asset_types at ON a.asset_type_id = at.asset_type_id
